articles.summary: Karman Space & Defense Awarded $31 Million U.S. Navy Contract for Virginia-class Submarine Propulsor Tailcones. Karman Space & Defense (NYSE: KRMN) has been awarded a five-year, $31 million contract by the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Carderock Division, to produce propulsor tailcones for the U.S. Navy’s Virginia-class attack submarines.
articles.title: Karman Space & Defense Awarded $31 Million U.S. Navy Contract for Virginia-class Submarine Propulsor Tailcones
